_about: Saved style (registers as style-tulvo-ugc-phone-take). A phone-first, hands-off 'screen share' product slice with a UGC feel: show first, say little, captions carry the line, proof is only what is on screen. Built and proved in jobs/2026-11-19-ugc-01 from library/fixtures/ugc-01/card.json.
name: UGC phone take

format.colour: BT.709 SDR, limited range, yuv420p, tagged bt709

structure.shows: a comment card (the question the film answers) drops in at frame 0 under a Replying-to line and takes a like tap; the product screen is pushed in behind it; one caption line
structure.caption: one line, at most 7 words
sound: phone-buzz at frame 0 as the comment card drops
impact-soft as the first caption lands

structure.shows: one pointer-led path: a click-through cut at the sidebar item, then the camera follows the pointer to the New button and a glow opens on hover
structure.caption: one to two lines, naming the action
sound: finger-tap on each tap (finger-tap-like on the heart)

structure.shows: the board held; a ring on the board's title; names only what is visible: no numbers, no result claims
structure.caption: one line, only what is on screen

structure.shows: a wipe to the light stage; the offer line, then the wordmark
structure.caption: none: the offer line is the large type

captions.emphasis: one word or phrase per line in the brand's highlight colour, heavier weight
captions.style: dark glass pill, brand headline typeface, words arrive as they are 'spoken'; no voice needed
captions.safeArea: nothing that matters within 5% of any edge (54 px sides, 96 px top and bottom)

pacing.cameraMove: slow push in every hold (zoom 2.4 to 2.9 on a 16:9 still in a 9:16 window); camera follows the pointer, never cuts away from the product
cutsOnScreen: hook to demo: hard cut on the whip
sidebar click to the next page: instant swap 3 frames after the click

broll.rule: none needed: the product is the b-roll. Use real product captures only; if a person clip is ever added it must be cleared first (none exists today).
allowed: owner-cleared product capture stills or recordings
never: any footage of a person without a clearance record

cta.ownerApprovalForWording: delegated to lead 2026-11-19; no pricing claim

sound.kit: library/sounds/kit.json (brand files in brands/tulvo/sounds win where present)

bed.note: nobody has listened to it: listen first

music.note: off for a UGC feel; if on, duck under any voice (mix.py --duck-db)

sound.voice: placeholder: captions carry the line; paid TTS or an owner recording is pending
sound.levelRule: with no voice, effects are measured against a stand-in level (mix.py --ref-db) and mastered to -14 LUFS, true peak at or below -1 dBTP

grade.note: one recipe per clip; graded pictures are written once and read by both the preview and the export; reset returns a clip to neutral

adUse: paid-cleared or original only; ViralHooks clips organic-only

rights.note: Internal draft. The Kestrel Studio stills have no recorded public-use clearance.
